o: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

eps.o: Neverland Ranch, 2003. A shocking documentary ignites a PR firestorm for Michael Jackson and his inner circle, sparking scrutiny and dark allegations.
The trial begins in 2005. As press, protestors and fans swarm the courthouse, Jackson's star power and savvy defense team throw the jury into doubt.
Despite damning accounts from former Neverland workers, key witnesses turn the tide in Jackson's favor — but the trial nevertheless leaves deep wounds.
